# Higgsfield

> Higgsfield is a multi-model AI platform for video, image, editing, storyboarding, and commercial content creation. This static index lists 94 public apps, 22 app collections, and the core feature surfaces present in this codebase.

Higgsfield combines multi-model generation, one-click creative apps, cinematic controls, editing workflows, community feeds, and team collaboration in a single product surface.

## Creator Hub
- [Creator Hub](https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub): Higgsfield's public content hub for guides, product updates, help, case studies, and Academy discovery.
- [Blog](https://higgsfield.ai/blog): How-to guides, editorial analysis, listicles, and inside-Higgsfield stories.
- [Changelog](https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog): Dated product releases, features, improvements, and fixes. RSS: [feed](https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog/rss.xml).
- [Help Center](https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center): Product guidance and troubleshooting articles.
- [Customer Stories](https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/case-studies): Creator and customer stories about work made with Higgsfield.
- [Academy](https://higgsfield.ai/academy): Structured Higgsfield learning and courses.

## Core Products
- [AI Video](https://higgsfield.ai/ai-video): Multi-model AI video generation across Sora, Kling, Veo, WAN, Seedance, and more.
- [AI Image](https://higgsfield.ai/ai-image): Multi-model AI image generation across Nano Banana, Soul, FLUX, GPT Image, Seedream, and more.
- [Apps](https://higgsfield.ai/apps): Directory of one-click creative apps, templates, and commercial-ready presets.
- [Cinema Studio](https://higgsfield.ai/cinematic-video-generator): Cinematic generation with camera bodies, lenses, motion presets, and film-style controls.
- [Storyboard Generator](https://higgsfield.ai/storyboard-generator): Create multi-scene storyboards with character consistency and export-ready sequences.
- [Image Editing](https://higgsfield.ai/image-editing): Inpainting and targeted image editing workflows.
- [Team Plan](https://higgsfield.ai/team-plan): Shared workspace, credits, and collaboration flows for teams.
- [Enterprise](https://higgsfield.ai/enterprise): Enterprise plan with admin controls, security, and scalable production workflows.
- [Enterprise Help Center](https://higgsfield.ai/enterprise-help-center): Guides for enterprise onboarding, workspaces, credits, security, and creative workflows. Every article is also served as Markdown at its URL plus `.md`; the article index is at [retrieval.json](https://higgsfield.ai/enterprise-help-center/retrieval.json).

## Workspace Features
- [Create Image](https://higgsfield.ai/image): Primary authenticated image-generation workspace.

- [Moodboard](https://higgsfield.ai/moodboard): Build visual direction and reusable mood/style references.
- [Chat](https://higgsfield.ai/chat): In-product chat and collaboration surface.
- [Upscale](https://higgsfield.ai/upscale): Image and video enhancement, upscaling, and cleanup.
- [Animate](https://higgsfield.ai/animate): Animate existing assets and smart replacement workflows.
- [Video Edit](https://higgsfield.ai/video-edit): Dedicated video-editing surface for scene and shot changes.
- [Keyframes](https://higgsfield.ai/keyframes): Keyframe-driven image and video creation workflows.
- [Draw to Edit](https://higgsfield.ai/edit?generationType=image&model=veo-instruct): Sketch-guided image editing and inpainting.
- [Draw to Video](https://higgsfield.ai/edit?generationType=video&model=veo-instruct): Sketch-guided video generation and editing.

## AI Models

## Academy

Higgsfield Academy is the platform's learning surface: free, structured courses that teach actual creation workflows. Unlike the interactive workspaces, Academy lesson prose is server-rendered — the full text, headings, and tables are present in the HTML without executing JavaScript, so the content is directly crawlable and citable. Courses group hands-on lessons, and selected courses award a completion certificate.

- [Academy](https://higgsfield.ai/academy): Learning hub and course catalog.
- [Courses](https://higgsfield.ai/academy/courses): Multi-lesson courses with hands-on lessons and optional completion certificates.

- [Blockbuster 4K: The AI Filmmaking Pipeline](https://higgsfield.ai/academy/courses/blockbuster-4k): A 40-minute filmmaking pipeline covering story beats, reusable character, prop, and location assets, controlled generations, take selection, and final assembly.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Higgsfield?**
A: Higgsfield is a browser-based AI creation platform that combines public landings, logged-in creation workspaces, one-click apps, and community surfaces for video, image, editing, storyboarding, and commercial creative production.

**Q: What is the difference between `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt`?**
A: `llms.txt` is the compact machine-readable index. `llms-full.txt` is the expanded version with higher-context descriptions, product framing, and FAQ-style guidance.

**Q: Is Higgsfield only a video tool?**
A: No. The public surface clearly spans video, image generation, image editing, cinematic workflows, moodboarding, lip sync, AI influencer creation, and a large app catalog.

**Q: Does Higgsfield have authenticated creation workspaces?**
A: Yes. Public landing pages route into logged-in workspaces such as `/image`, `/video`, `/cinema-studio`, `/lipsync-studio`, and related editing surfaces.

**Q: What models does Higgsfield expose publicly?**
A: The public landings currently include Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, WAN AI Video, WAN 2.6, Seedance 2.0, Grok Imagine, Nano Banana Pro, Nano Banana 2, FLUX 2, GPT Image 1.5, Seedream 5.0, Soul 2.0, Soul Cinema, and Soul Cast.

**Q: Does Higgsfield support face swap?**
A: Yes. The public app catalog includes both photo face swap and video face swap, plus adjacent tools such as character swap and recast.

**Q: Does Higgsfield support product ads and commercial content?**
A: Yes. The app collections and app directory include many commercial utilities such as link-to-video ads, packshots, billboard concepts, macro product scenes, ASMR promos, and realistic ad placements.

**Q: Can I build recurring characters or AI personas?**
A: Yes. The public product surface includes Character, Soul Cast, AI Influencer, AI Influencer Studio, and several identity-focused app collections and tools.

**Q: Is there a public community or feed?**
A: Yes. Higgsfield exposes a main community page plus model-specific or format-specific community surfaces such as Soul, Sora, WAN, Seedance, Kling, and mixed-media showcases.

**Q: Does Higgsfield include collaboration features?**
A: Yes. Public surfaces reference team plans, enterprise paths, chat, shared projects, and collaboration-oriented workspace entries.

**Q: How large is the public app footprint in this static snapshot?**
A: The current snapshot represented here includes 22 public app collections and 94 public app entries.

**Q: Is there a route for commercial or UGC-specific work?**
A: Yes. The public sitemap and product surfaces include `commercial`, `ugc`, apps for ads and products, and creator-oriented tools such as Lipsync Studio and AI influencer flows.

**Q: Can users move from public landings into logged-in workspaces?**
A: Yes. The platform repeatedly uses public discovery pages such as `ai-video`, `ai-image`, and model landings as top-of-funnel entry points into authenticated creation surfaces like `create/video`, `image`, `cinema-studio`, and `video-edit`.

**Q: Does Higgsfield expose community content by model or style?**
A: Yes. In addition to the main `community` feed, there are dedicated public feeds or showcase surfaces for Soul, Soul Cinema, Kling 3.0, Seedance, Sora video, WAN video, and mixed-media content.

**Q: Is there a distinct cinematic workflow separate from generic generation?**
A: Yes. The product exposes both public cinematic landings and dedicated logged-in surfaces such as `cinematic-video-generator`, `cinema-studio`, `camera-controls`, `storyboard-generator`, and `keyframes`.

**Q: Does Higgsfield cover both discovery and finished-content publishing?**
A: Yes. The product surface spans top-of-funnel landings, hands-on creation workspaces, app-level utilities, community feeds, and viewer-facing destinations like Original Series.

**Q: Does Higgsfield have learning material or tutorials?**
A: Yes. Higgsfield Academy (`/academy`) is a dedicated learning surface with free multi-lesson courses such as Blockbuster 4K: The AI Filmmaking Pipeline and Add AI VFX to Real Footage.

**Q: Where should I learn how to use a specific Higgsfield tool?**
A: Academy courses at `/academy/courses` teach end-to-end workflows; some courses award completion certificates.

[data-explore-layout] {
  container-type: inline-size;
  overflow-anchor: none;
  column-count: auto;
  --explore-columns: 2;
  --explore-gap: var(--spacing-q-400, 1rem);
  --explore-row-gap: var(--spacing-q-400, 1rem);
}

[data-explore-layout='2'] {
  --explore-gap: var(--spacing-q-200, 0.5rem);
}

[data-explore-layout='5'],
[data-explore-layout='6'] {
  --explore-gap: var(--spacing-q-200, 0.5rem);
  --explore-row-gap: var(--spacing-q-200, 0.5rem);
}

[data-explore-layout] > [data-explore-grid] {
  --explore-column-width: calc((100cqw - (var(--explore-columns) - 1) * var(--explore-gap)) / var(--explore-columns));
  position: relative;
  column-gap: var(--explore-gap);
  row-gap: var(--explore-row-gap);
  height: var(--explore-height-2);
}

[data-explore-grid] > [data-explore-item] {
  position: absolute;
  width: var(--explore-column-width);
  left: calc(var(--explore-x-2) * (var(--explore-column-width) + var(--explore-gap)));
  top: var(--explore-y-2);
}

@container (max-width: 24rem) {
  [data-explore-layout] > [data-explore-grid] {
    --explore-columns: 1;
    height: var(--explore-height-1);
  }

    left: 0;

}
